defects.failure: A workflow appeared green although a required check was skipped, blocked, cancelled, stale, absent, duplicate, or malformed.
defects.missing_invariant: Every required check must provide unambiguous executable evidence for the exact expected commit.

defects.failure: The artifact available for upload or release was not necessarily the artifact that passed the test.
defects.missing_invariant: A passing artifact report must match the bytes present when the aggregate gate runs.
defects.regression_fixture: test/gate.test.mjs: changing an artifact after its test invalidates PASS

defects.failure: Uploaded or released bytes could differ from the locally tested bytes.
defects.missing_invariant: The downloaded published artifact must have the same SHA-256 as the tested artifact.
defects.regression_fixture: test/gate.test.mjs: same-bytes compares content rather than filenames

defects.failure: A green Android build did not establish that the final APK aligned, verified, installed, reinstalled with the same signer, and launched on the target Android version.
defects.missing_invariant: The exact signed final APK must pass alignment, signature, package identity, clean-install, same-signer reinstall, and launch checks on Android 14.

defects.failure: Provisioning appeared complete without the documented stable command succeeding on a stock Debian, Ubuntu, or Hetzner host.
defects.missing_invariant: The documented entry command must succeed from a declared clean base image without ambient workstation state.

defects.failure: Generated C compiled even though the claimed Grease or Idriç source-to-artifact path had not actually executed and an ambient fallback could satisfy CI.
defects.missing_invariant: The owned source language compiler and generated-output boundary must be observed, and undeclared fallback executors must be absent.

defects.failure: Script, captions, on-screen text, and voiceover could diverge while individual files remained syntactically valid.
defects.missing_invariant: All derived text and voice assets must identify one canonical source and prove the expected derivation or exact transcript match.

defects.failure: A media asset could be present without preserving creator, source, license, and meaningful modification or uploader history required for reuse.
defects.missing_invariant: Every rendered external asset must resolve to a complete machine-checkable provenance entry appropriate to its license.

defects.failure: A video rendered successfully while required mathematical objects or styles, such as visible red dotted perpendicular bisectors, were absent.
defects.missing_invariant: The scene must emit a semantic manifest and an independent check must establish each required object, relation, style, visibility interval, and safe-frame constraint.
